tools.name: peerlytics_activity
tools.description: Read recent public Peer protocol activity on Base and open its interactive receipt desk. Returns a bounded latest sample, never all-time totals.

tools.name: peerlytics_receipt
tools.description: Look up a public intent hash or chain-qualified deposit identifier. Preserves indexed settlement evidence, timestamps and provenance; never initiates a financial action or returns payee or payment identifiers.
